title: Norman Khan b2b Generator - Ancient Circuits
file: Norman Khan b2b generator - Ancient Circuits.opus
description: After a long hiatus we're back! Teaming up with long-time friend Generator once again for a marathon 4h30 mix. We covered some serious ground in this one, starting off in minimal territory we move into some deeper psyprog, tempo ranges from 130 - 147 over the course of this mix so it's a long journey, threw in an absolutely classic unreleased Son Kite tune at 2h30 mark, literally taken off a live dvd they did! :P Artwork: John Martin - The Great Day of His Wrath (1851)

title: The PsyRock Mix
description:
This is a funny genre that really kinda vanished into thin air, there was a good while where a ton of guitar-heavy psytrance was coming out, SUN project, C.O.N Sequencer and various others, this mix is entirely what I call 'psyrock' (not to be confused with psychedelic rock) but yeah guitar heavy stuff took a while to collect these guys!

Artwork by Leon Devenice

title: 100 Follower Special!
description: Did this mix to celebrate 100 followers on SoundCloud, unfortunately they're charging 75 quid a year these days for artist plus membership so they can suck a fat one >:( First half is slow psytrance kicking around 110 - 120bpm then second half pitch it up to 135 and get into some psyprog goodness enjoy this, I put a lot of time and effort into it :) Cover art: Sesshu Toyo, Winter Landscape, c. 1470

title: IYE003 - Norman Khan (Influence Ears)
description:
Huge thanks to Wit Wiki and Wilko duo down under for asking me to put this mix together, the fact that these guys reached out to my little obscure internet presence really shows that they know their shit and they are some real ones ;) [Influence Ears Page]

In the spirit of all things progressive, I've sequenced an hour of progressive (psy)trance, breaks, house and a few things in between it all.

The best metaphor I have for this mix is that of an hour-long roller coaster, so strap-in!

Once again big thanks to Influence Ears for inviting me on! Keep your ears peeled and your calendars free, great things in the pipeline from these guys :)

title: Norman Khan b2b Generator - The Shadow Dance: A Dark Journey

tracklist.title: Kommdas (2001)     b2b generator the shadow dance

description:
Aaaaaaaaand we're back!

After a small hiatus, I have joined forces with my long-time friend and fellow music hoarder Generator.

Together we have conjured a 2 and a half hour dark trip, shoutout to all those who have listened to my mixes in the past and have brought to light the tunes that would have been lost to time. You know who you are ;)

Feel free to play the sample bingo as you listen :)

description:
Fuck you SoundCloud, making me fork out £60 just to upload this shit.

After collecting old prog-house almost 5 years now it's finally time to put a mix together in probably my favourite genre of all time. Starting heady with some classics, this ends up going deep and dark before coming back up at the end.

title: Sound of Whomp w/ Norman Khan
description: Mother of Whomp Party, Annx invites, Norman Khan for the latest ‘Sound of Whomp’. Expect an hour-long journey paying homage to the minimal/progressive sound exclusively featuring tunes from between the years of 1996-2004. Look out for samples from Toy Story and Office Space, dark room recommended.
